records.title: Recruitment of Doctors
details: a to c: Government of Maharashtra has informed that in the year 2025, advertisements regarding 1,286 teaching posts were published by Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) for filling teaching faculty across state. Out of these, recommendations for 158 posts have been received, and action for appointment is being taken as per procedure. The recruitment process for the remaining posts is under progress with MPSC.

records.title: Expansion of Runway at Kolhapur Airport
details:
(a): For extension of runway to 2300 meter at Kolhapur Airport, the Airports Authority of India (AAI) has projected a land requirement of 65.71 acres to the State Government of Maharashtra. Out of the total land requirement, 22.12 acre land has been taken over by AAI. The commencement of the runway extension work is contingent upon the handing over of the remaining land by the State
Government, free from all encumbrances, to AAI.
